mapper.update: UPDATE quant_execution_record SET execution_status='CONFIRMED', exchange_order_id=COALESCE(#{orderId},exchange_order_id), exchange_order_status=#{exchangeStatus}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND execution_status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND (exchange_order_id IS NULL OR exchange_order_id=#{orderId}) AND #{orderId} IS NOT NULL AND #{orderId}>0

UPDATE quant_execution_record SET execution_status='RECOVERED', exchange_order_id=COALESCE(#{orderId},exchange_order_id), exchange_order_status=COALESCE(#{exchangeStatus},exchange_order_status), updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND execution_status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','CONFIRMED') AND (exchange_order_id IS NULL OR exchange_order_id=#{orderId}) AND #{orderId} IS NOT NULL AND #{orderId}>0

UPDATE quant_execution_record SET recovery_attempts=COALESCE(recovery_attempts,0)+1, last_recovery_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND execution_status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','CONFIRMED')
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.credential_id AS credentialId, e.symbol, e.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, e.client_order_id AS clientOrderId, e.exchange_order_id AS exchangeOrderId, e.operation_type AS operationType, e.execution_status AS executionStatus FROM quant_execution_record e JOIN quant_live_dispatch_guard g ON g.credential_id=e.credential_id AND g.symbol=e.symbol AND g.active_dispatch_key=e.idempotency_key JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=e.credential_id AND t.symbol=e.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=e.idempotency_key AND t.client_order_id=e.client_order_id WHERE e.execution_status='RECOVERED' AND t.dispatch_status IN ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN') AND t.operation_type IN ('OPEN','CLOSE','CANCEL') ORDER BY g.updated_at ASC LIMIT 100
